project_info.name: Sawari
project_info.description: Cab headrest digital advertising platform based in Pune, India. Cabs mounted with 10.1" interactive screens behind front headrests.
project_info.pricing: ₹4,300 per cab per month (Minimum 15 cabs required for booking)
project_info.tech_stack: React.js (JavaScript), Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, Recharts, Framer Motion, Shadcn UI primitives, FastAPI backend, MongoDB

admin_ops.name: Sawari Control Hub (Admin & Operations)
admin_ops.theme_mode: Dark slate / Clean high-density SaaS dashboard
core_features: Executive KPI Dashboard (Active Cabs, Ad Impressions, Fleet Revenue, Active Ads)
Interactive Slot Visualiser Grid with 4 status colors (Green=Available, Amber=Booked, Grey=Offline, Red=Faulty)
Ad Review & Approval Queue with 16:9 simulated screen player
Fleet Input & Registration System
Advertisers & Drivers Management Tables
Driver Payouts & Automated Billing Engine
Finance Dashboard & Incident Management Tracker

business.name: Sawari Advertiser Portal (Business Owners)
business.theme_mode: Warm premium dark/light hybrid SaaS interface
business.target_user: Pune Local Business Owners (Gyms, Restaurants, Showrooms, Real Estate)
core_features: Business Overview with Live Ad Play Counter & Reach Metrics
Creatives Library with Status Badges (Approved, Pending Review, Rejected)
Video Upload Flow with 16:9 Cab Headrest Screen Simulator Modal
Book Slots Engine: Real-time fleet availability, interactive slot grid, cab count stepper (min 15 cabs), live total pricing breakdown
GST Invoice Generator & Mock Payment Drawer (UPI QR, Card, NetBanking)
Campaign Performance Analytics & CSV Data Exporter
Billing ledger with CGST/SGST split breakdown & Printable GST Invoices

partner.name: Sawari Partner App (Driver Portal)
partner.theme_mode: Mobile-First Driver App (Phone-shaped max-w-[460px] centered container, dark high-contrast driver UI)
partner.target_user: Cab Drivers in Pune operating registered vehicles
core_features: 44px+ Touch Target Mobile Interface with Sticky Bottom Tab Bar
Today Tab: Active Duty Toggle, Today's Earnings, What's On Screen Live Stream, Compliance Status Banner
15-Day Compliance Photo Verification: Camera capture modal with grid overlay and instant sample submission
Earnings & Payout Ledger: Monthly payout breakdown, trip bonuses, payment history
Device Status Monitor: Screen hardware telemetry, battery/power check, cellular signal status
Driver Profile & Vehicle Specs

design_system.style_archetype: Clean Professional Tech SaaS with High-Density Data Precision

layout_and_spacing.padding_strategy: Generous spacing system using p-4, p-6, p-8 with strict border padding to prevent text collision
layout_and_spacing.grid_rules: All grid children must be direct elements or subgrids with align-items: start
layout_and_spacing.radius: rounded-xl for cards and modals, rounded-lg for buttons, rounded-full for badges

login_experience.strategy: Single entry portal landing with 3 prominent portal selector tabs (Admin, Business, Partner) or direct route access (/login/admin, /login/business, /login/partner)
login_experience.visual_style: Hero background featuring Pune cityscape and cab interior headrest display with brand badge
login_experience.demo_credentials: Provide quick-click 'Demo Auto-Fill' buttons for fast evaluator testing

slot_visualiser_requirements: Interactive grid showing 100+ cab slots color-coded (Green=Available, Amber=Booked, Grey=Offline, Red=Faulty)
Filter slots by zone (Koregaon Park, Baner, Viman Nagar, Hinjewadi, Swargate, Kothrud)
Click on slot to view Cab ID, Driver details, hardware telemetry, and assign/unassign creative
Quick statistics bar: Total Cabs (e.g. 250), Booked Slots (165), Available (72), Faulty/Offline (13)
tables_requirements: Paginated data tables with search, status filters, and action dropdown menus
Ad Review Queue: 16:9 thumbnail preview, advertiser name, campaign budget, Approve / Reject buttons with rejection reason modal

booking_flow_requirements: Step 1: Select Pune Zones & Vehicle Quantity (Minimum 15 cabs stepper, ₹4,300/cab/month)
Step 2: Slot Grid Selection & Creative Attachment
Step 3: GST Breakdown (Base amount + 9% CGST + 9% SGST = Total ₹ INR)
Step 4: Mock Payment Drawer (UPI QR code timer simulation, Card details, Instant Invoice download)
business_portal.creative_simulator: Interactive 16:9 headrest screen mockup showing simulated passenger viewing ad with volume toggle and overlay controls

partner_portal.container: mx-auto max-w-[460px] min-h-screen bg-slate-950 border-x border-slate-800 relative pb-20 shadow-2xl
partner_portal.navigation: Fixed bottom tab bar with 4 tabs: Today, Earnings, Device, Profile
compliance_photo_feature: Interactive camera view with headrest box alignment mask
Simulated photo capture, quality check preview, and instant submit action

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all three portals have independent routing and navigation bars.
Do not render Admin links inside Business or Partner navigation bars.
Maintain strict color accent identity: Blue for Admin/Ops, Amber/Gold for Business, Green for Partner.
Ensure the Partner Portal is rendered in a mobile phone frame container with min-width and max-width 460px centered horizontally.
All modals (Checkout, Camera compliance, Ad preview simulator, Rejection reason) must use Shadcn Dialog / Sheet components with smooth transitions.
All interactive and key statistical components MUST contain data-testid attributes listed in the guidelines.
